name: pet-toy-shop-api
description: NestJS backend for a domestic pet toy independent shop.

scripts.build: node scripts/clean-build.mjs && set PATH=C:\Program Files\nodejs;%PATH%&& node_modules\.bin\tsc.cmd -p tsconfig.build.json && node scripts/write-cloud-pet-release-marker.mjs
scripts.web:dev: set PATH=C:\Program Files\nodejs;%PATH%&& node_modules\.bin\next.cmd dev web -p 3001
scripts.web:build: set PATH=C:\Program Files\nodejs;%PATH%&& node_modules\.bin\next.cmd build web
scripts.prisma:migrate: set PATH=C:\Program Files\nodejs;%PATH%&& node_modules\.bin\prisma.cmd migrate dev
scripts.prisma:migrate:deploy: set PATH=C:\Program Files\nodejs;%PATH%&& node_modules\.bin\prisma.cmd migrate deploy
scripts.smoke:production: set CLOUD_PET_RELEASE_ID=production-smoke-release&& npm run build && npm run web:build && node scripts/production-smoke.mjs
scripts.smoke:cloud-pet-prisma: npm run build && set PATH=C:\Program Files\nodejs;%PATH%&& node_modules\.bin\ts-node.cmd scripts/cloud-pet-prisma-smoke.ts
scripts.smoke:cloud-pet-ops-config-prisma: npm run build && set PATH=C:\Program Files\nodejs;%PATH%&& node_modules\.bin\ts-node.cmd scripts/cloud-pet-ops-config-prisma-smoke.ts
scripts.api:dev:memory: set NODE_ENV=test&& set KZT_USE_MEMORY_STORE=true&& set DATABASE_URL=&& set PATH=C:\Program Files\nodejs;%PATH%&& node_modules\.bin\ts-node.cmd src/main.ts
